verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has an extensive public API reference covering customers, monitoring, cases, audit, exports and transactions. It also documents API credentials, rate limiting and versioning, and offers a Postman collection plus a downloadable OpenAPI schema; a probe retrieved and parsed that OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. The probe's 404s on guessed default paths do not contradict this, since the schema exists at a different path. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of an authenticated API operation actually executing (the probe retrieved documentation only).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
